## Notes
\

\
* branches can be created using plain git
\
* `.git/machete` is the only state git-machete keeps and can be hand-edited
\
* alternatively, use `git machete discover` with appropriate flags to let git-machete auto-discover branch stack
\
* creating PRs through git machete ensures target branches are correctly set and PR descriptions hold "machete blocks" for easy navigation through the PR stack
